sources.access_method: HTTPS batch ZIP downloads; Phase 2 sampled the standard English master-list path only; Translingual not evaluated
sources.license_note: Provider Terms of Use permit dataset use without fee and redistribution with GDELT attribution/link; inspected 2026-09-06. Linked publisher article rights are separate. See docs/PHASE_2_REPORT.md.
sources.update_frequency: 15-minute batches per provider documentation; continuity requires empirical validation
sources.geographic_coverage: Global news monitoring; representativeness and per-geography completeness unknown
sources.historical_coverage: 24 selected older batches from 2015-03-02 through 2026-08-05 acquired successfully; availability between sampled windows and retention guarantees unknown
sources.reliability_note: Phase 3: 96/96 verified archive revisions; 118415 syntactically accepted rows, 5 lossless quarantines; 96/96 independent replay matches. Recommendation promote_to_ingestion_candidate applies only to raw/parsing/provenance; no indicator validation or production activation. See docs/PHASE_3_REPORT.md.
sources.bias_note: Media selection, syndication, language coverage and extraction affect observations; media attention is not societal severity
sources.cost_note: Measured 494483985 compressed bytes for 96 study batches. Recent 72-batch mean extrapolates to about 164 decimal GB/year for this feed only; not a full-year measurement or paid-service commitment.
